items.title: Special termination right for price increase
items.quote: Sie können binnen drei Monaten ab Zugang dieses Schreibens kostenfrei kündigen; der Vertrag endet frühestens mit Wirksamwerden der Änderung.
items.computation: The letter is dated Fri 05.12.2025; this is a company (not an authority), so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies and the actual receipt date is unknown, so the letter's own date is used as the earliest plausible start of 'Zugang'. Counting the 3-month period under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of receipt (05.12.2025) is not counted; the period starts 06.12.2025. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of months ends with the expiry of the day of the last month that bears the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. the 5th of the third following month: 05.03.2026 (Thursday), not a weekend or NRW public holiday, so no shift applies. The special cancellation only ends the contract 'frühestens mit Wirksamwerden der Änderung' (01.02.2026), but the deadline to exercise the right by sending the cancellation is the end of the 3-month period, 05.03.2026.

warnings: The 3-month special-cancellation deadline was calculated from the letter's printed date (05.12.2025) because the actual day it arrived is not stated; if it arrived later, the deadline shifts later by the same number of days — confirm the real delivery date before relying on 05.03.2026 as the last day to cancel.

The price increase takes effect on 01.02.2026, before the 3-month cancellation window (ending 05.03.2026) closes, so one higher-priced month may be billed even if you cancel using the special right within the stated period; check the exact billing cut-off with the provider if this matters.
